name: TraceCheck
description: Self-check for AI agents: verify your run before you report success. Send your goal, the steps you took and the outcome you claim; get a reliability score (0-100), per-dimension sub-scores, the issues found (loops, unrecovered errors, success claimed without evidence, no verification) and concrete fixes. No content needed: send step types only (privacy-light format); no goal/trace/outcome text is logged or stored. Free during test phase, no API key. Also available as an MCP server (streamable HTTP) at https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/mcp with tools evaluate_trace and get_trace_schema. Summary for agents: https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/llms.txt

skills.name: Verify my run (evaluate agent execution trace)
skills.description: Self-check before reporting success: did I succeed? Score an agent's multi-step execution trace (evaluate trace, detect loops, reliability score) for reliability and return concrete improvement suggestions. No content needed: send step types only. Send POST /a2a/message:send (or JSON-RPC message/send at POST /a2a) with one message part {"data": {"goal": str, "trace": str | list, "outcome": str, "agent_name": str (optional)}}. Privacy-light (recommended): goal = a generic category ('data lookup'), outcome = 'success'|'partial'|'failed', trace = step types + statuses only, e.g. [{"type":"action","tool":"search","status":"ok"},{"type":"error"},{"type":"retry"},{"type":"verify","status":"passed"}] or 'action:search ok > error > retry > verify passed'. Free text also works: chronological steps, one per line, with what each tool returned, errors with their recovery, and a final 'Verified:' line. Nothing you send is logged or stored, only the score and counts. Returns a Message whose data part is {score, dimensions, issues, suggestions, summary, privacy_mode, version}. Loop: run task, evaluate, apply suggestions, re-run, compare.
examples: Verify my run before I report success.
Did I succeed? Here is what I did: action:search ok > action:book error > retry:book ok > verify passed > final
Self-check my trace and detect loops.
Evaluate this trace for the goal 'book a flight and confirm the reservation'.
Check if my multi-step research process completed correctly and suggest improvements.
